Event.info: ARTEX AI pentest framework: exposed consoles, backdoored Docker image lineage, trojan-distribution hunt

Attribute.comment: Docker Hub image whose /app/artex carries the pre-auth command-execution backdoor (verifyCaptcha). Repo removed; tag metadata still served on 2026-11-15; registry pulls answer 401 [type: docker-image; verdict: malicious; source: Blackfish Security (darkfibr/artex-forensics); Docker Hub tag metadata; static analysis of the binary (this case)]

Second Docker Hub namespace serving the same backdoor build: index and manifest digests identical to tomicdd/artex (tag metadata read 2026-11-13); registry pulls answer 401 on 2026-11-15 [type: docker-image; verdict: malicious; source: Docker Hub tag metadata (this case); The Hacker News]

image index digest of the backdoor image (tag latest), same under tomicdd/artex and congdonglinux/artex [type: docker-digest; verdict: malicious; source: Docker Hub tag metadata (this case); Blackfish Security]
amd64 manifest digest of the backdoor image [type: docker-digest; verdict: malicious; source: Docker Hub tag metadata (this case); Blackfish Security]

payload layer of the backdoor image (contains only /app/artex); value from Blackfish, layers were not obtainable by us [type: docker-digest; verdict: malicious; source: Blackfish Security (not re-derived: registry 401)]

/app/artex ELF of the backdoor image (static Go, 51,210,988 B, not stripped); carries the injected verifyCaptcha backdoor [type: sha256; verdict: malicious; source: Blackfish Security; MalwareBazaar copy; static analysis (this case)]
Go build ID of the backdoored binary (read from the ELF note by us; equals Blackfish value) [type: go-build-id; verdict: malicious; source: static analysis (this case); Blackfish Security]

buildinfo vcs.revision of the backdoored binary (vcs.modified=true, vcs.time 2026-10-08T13:45:50Z, version v0.3.16-0.20261008134550-5c0dbd4bec94+dirty); not in the public Autumn-27 or RuoJi6 history (765 commits checked), so the backdoor tree is unverifiable [type: go-vcs-revision; verdict: malicious; source: static analysis (this case)]

injected backdoor function (160 B): exec.Command("sh","-c",arg).CombinedOutput(); absent from every upstream tag checked; authLogin grows 1,600 to 2,112 B to call it [type: go-symbol; verdict: malicious; source: static analysis (this case); Blackfish Security]

Attribute.value: POST /api/auth/login with JSON "captcha" value starting with "!"
Attribute.comment: backdoor trigger: the rest of the value runs through sh -c and the output comes back in the JSON "captcha" field; the login route is exempt from authentication, so no credentials are needed [type: behaviour; verdict: malicious; source: static analysis (this case); Blackfish Security; The Hacker News (Badbyte)]

distribution reference for the backdoor image: docker-compose.yml pulls tomicdd/artex; 611 of its 623 forks descend from the compose-switch commit (commit identity). Hosting account only: who authored the change is a separate question (commit author trhhubsd) [type: github-repo; verdict: distribution-reference; source: GitHub API and git history (this case, 2026-11-15)]

distribution reference for the backdoor image: docker-compose.yml pulls tomicdd/artex; install-debian.sh downloads an unanalysed "dirty" binary over HTTP (see candidate rows). Hosting account only [type: github-repo; verdict: distribution-reference; source: GitHub API and git history (this case, 2026-11-15)]

commit "build: image changed to tomicdd/artex": the one-line compose switch to the backdoored image; commit metadata author trhhubsd, 2026-10-08T20:33:28Z, 52 min after the Docker Hub push at 19:41Z (timing medium: commit dates are committer-set) [type: git-commit; verdict: distribution-reference; source: GitHub API (this case)]

head of imxv/ARTEXX main on 2026-11-15: original v0.3.15 tree plus README changes plus the compose line pulling tomicdd/artex; no source-code change [type: git-commit; verdict: distribution-reference; source: git diff against the Autumn-27 v0.3.15 commit (this case)]

line in docker-compose.yml of copies that pull the backdoored image; grep target for repos, mirrors and internal build files [type: string; verdict: distribution-reference; source: GitHub API (this case)]

host named by default in luoxi0615/ARTEX install-debian.sh as the download source of a "dirty" linux-amd64 ZIP (plain HTTP, no checksum); payload never retrieved (two attempts timed out), so its content is UNRESOLVED, not shown malicious [type: domain; verdict: candidate; source: install script text (this case)]
default ZIP_URL of install-debian.sh in luoxi0615/ARTEX; payload not analysed (unresolved) [type: url; verdict: candidate; source: install script text (this case)]

HUNTING, not malicious: urlscan resource hash of GET /api/auth/status = sha256 of {"initialized":true}+LF (21 B); the unauthenticated ARTEX backend status body. Generic alone: use with the title or favicon, and expect legitimate testers and forks [type: urlscan-resource-hash; verdict: hunting-pivot; source: urlscan result pages; ARTEX source auth.go (this case)]

HUNTING, not malicious: sha256 of {"initialized":false}+LF (22 B): status body of a console with no admin password set yet (first visitor can set it). One such unit seen [type: urlscan-resource-hash; verdict: hunting-pivot; source: urlscan result pages; ARTEX source auth.go (this case)]

HUNTING: sha256 of the ARTEX console /favicon.ico (15,086 B); urlscan hash: query. Shared by forks and legitimate deployments [type: resource-sha256; verdict: hunting-pivot; source: ARTEX web source (this case)]

HUNTING: sha256 of the console /icon.png and /logo.png (492,065 B); urlscan hash: query. Shared by forks and legitimate deployments [type: resource-sha256; verdict: hunting-pivot; source: ARTEX web source (this case)]
HUNTING: sha256 of the console /logo.svg (63,981 B). Shared by forks and legitimate deployments [type: resource-sha256; verdict: hunting-pivot; source: ARTEX web source (this case)]
HUNTING: Shodan-style mmh3 of the console favicon.ico [type: favicon-mmh3; verdict: hunting-pivot; source: ARTEX web source (this case)]
HUNTING: Shodan-style mmh3 of the console icon.png / logo.png [type: favicon-mmh3; verdict: hunting-pivot; source: ARTEX web source (this case)]
